summary.summary_zh: PaddlePaddle 发布 PP-DocLayoutV3 的 safetensors 格式模型权重，这是一个专为非平面文档图像设计的统一版面检测模型，作为 PaddleOCR-VL 1.5/1.6 与 GLM-OCR 的核心版面分析组件。该模型可直接预测版面元素的多点边界框（而非标准两点框），并在单次前向传播内确定倾斜与弯曲表面的逻辑阅读顺序，显著减少级联误差。相比原 PaddlePaddle 权重仓库，本版本以 safetensors 格式发布，可通过 transformers 库（AutoModelForObjectDetection）直接加载使用。该工作已被 ECCV 2026 接收。

innovations.title: 多点边界框预测
innovations.detail: 直接预测版面元素的多点边界框（polygon points），区别于标准两点框，专门处理倾斜、弯曲等非平面文档表面

innovations.title: 单前向传播端到端版面分析
innovations.detail: 在单次前向传播内同时完成版面元素检测与逻辑阅读顺序判定，显著减少级联误差

summary.progress_note: 本次发布为已有 PP-DocLayoutV3 模型的 safetensors 格式权重版本，模型能力本身未变化，主要为格式与生态兼容性提升

pretrain_innovations: Bottom-up data construction with hierarchical sampling from massive raw image pool
10,000 fine-grained visual category classification for long-tail sample balance
ERNIE-Image-Aes aesthetic scoring as unified quality signal for filtering and sampling
Three-stage progressive resolution training (256/512/1024) with diverse aspect ratios
Ministral-3 (3B) text encoder reducing memory consumption
posttrain_innovations: Top-down SFT data curation for high-demand priority domains
Diversified SFT annotations covering various user input styles for robustness
Improved DPO with few steps to align human aesthetic preferences and minimize reward hacking
MT-DMD strategy using multiple expert variants for joint supervision in Turbo (8 NFE) training
Lightweight Prompt Enhancer expanding concise user intents into structured descriptions
